title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before placing tables, chairs or other furniture on a footpath, road or other public land for outdoor dining.

sources.title: Outdoor dining footpath trading permit brisbane city council
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit to use the public footpath for outdoor dining or to sell goods or services.

sources.title: Footpath and outdoor dining permits
sources.quote: The local law regulates the placement of tables and chairs on the footpath for dining purposes through a permit.
